title: Service report that celebrates a falling complaint count while the customer base halved, and a 50% 'risk cut' from 10 incidents to 5

planted.why: complaints per 1,000 customers rose from 20.0 to 30.0; the raw count fell only because the customer base halved
a relative 50% rests on a handful of events (2 per 1,000 to 1 per 1,000 is a 0.1 percentage point change); it is within noise

proof.python:
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('data.csv')))
r0 = int(rows[0]['complaints']) / int(rows[0]['customers']) * 1000
r1 = int(rows[1]['complaints']) / int(rows[1]['customers']) * 1000
assert round(r0, 1) == 20.0 and round(r1, 1) == 30.0 and r1 > r0
assert int(rows[1]['complaints']) < int(rows[0]['complaints'])
